author: Robin Johansen (Dimora)
license: All rights reserved. Free to play, stream and review. Link, do not re-upload. No bundling, forks or derivatives without permission.

mod_jar.for: single player and server mods/ folder

modpack.for: players joining a server; import into Modrinth App or Prism Launcher

single_player: Put fabric-api-0.156.0+26.2.jar into the mods folder.
Put herobrine-<version>.jar into the mods folder.
server_host: Put both fabric-api-0.156.0+26.2.jar and herobrine-<version>.jar into mods/.
Start the server; players must run the same mod version.
server_players: Download the .mrpack from the latest release.
Import it into Modrinth App or Prism Launcher.
Launch from that profile (not the vanilla launcher).
